summary: All 3 requested flows PASS on the LIVE app (https://api.neksathi.in via preview) with demo@neksathi.app / demo1234, mobile viewport 390x844. (1) NEW ALERT RING (primary fix): after login, browser-side POST /api/public/qr/9a85011b-.../incident {type:'wrong_parking',note:'T1 test alert'} returned 200 with id=52f80e7a-... and within ~10s the toast '🔔 New wrong parking on MH14DEMO01 — open Alerts to view' appeared as a top-of-screen banner over the Security tab; app stayed healthy (no red screen, tab bar still interactive, expo-audio best-effort so no web crash from missing audio autoplay). (2) INCOMING CALL ACCEPT MESSAGE (reworded): POST /api/public/qr/.../call/start returned 200 with call_id=666beb5c-...; the ring overlay (testID incoming-call-overlay) appeared within ~5s showing 'Someone needs to reach you about vehicle MH14DEMO01' with Decline+Accept circles; tapping Accept (testID call-accept) dismissed the overlay AND displayed the honest toast "Live in-app voice answering isn't enabled in this version yet — the caller can still reach you on your registered number." — the old 'installed app build' wording is NOT present. (3) REGRESSION: Decline (testID call-decline) on a second call dismissed the overlay cleanly; Alerts Inbox opens via bell (17 rows rendered incl. the fresh 'Wrong Parking · Just Now MH14DEMO01' seeded above), and tapping the first row loads /alert-detail with the 'Wrong Parking' badge, timestamp, and empty-note/location fallbacks — full regression green. Ringtone asset intact at /app/frontend/assets/sounds/ringtone.wav (264KB). Only cosmetic web warnings remain (shadow*/pointerEvents deprecated, expo-notifications web listener no-op) — no functional impact.
critical_code_review_comments: LiveOverlays.tsx onAccept (line 146-149) now shows an honest message: 'Live in-app voice answering isn't enabled in this version yet — the caller can still reach you on your registered number.' — replaces the misleading 'installed app build' wording. Matches user intent.

Alert poll (lines 55-97) correctly primes knownAlerts on first fetch so historical alerts don't trigger toasts; only genuinely NEW alerts (after the first tick) fire the '🔔' toast + vibration + ringtone. Ringtone play is wrapped in try/catch so web autoplay restrictions don't crash the app.
Uses expo-audio (useAudioPlayer + setAudioModeAsync) — NOT deprecated expo-av — aligned with current Expo guidance.
callRef guard (line 75) prevents ringtone double-play when a call is already showing while an alert arrives — good UX detail.
